# WorldBox Modding Docs

> Community-driven WorldBox and NeoModLoader documentation built from real mods, runtime probes, logs, reproducible failures, and verified research.

## Research baseline
- WorldBox 0.51.2 build 719
- NeoModLoader 1.2.0.1

## Reliability policy
Technical claims use explicit reliability labels:
- Verified: reproduced and confirmed.
- Observed: seen at runtime, not fully explained.
- Experimental: currently works but remains under research.
- Inferred: evidence-backed conclusion without direct verification.
- Failed: tested approach known to be wrong or broken.
- Outdated: previously verified but not re-tested on the current version.

Do not invent undocumented WorldBox APIs. If an API or behavior is missing, mark it unverified and prefer a reflection/runtime probe.

## Main sections
- Getting Started
- Guides
- API Reference
- Troubleshooting
- Research

- AI Documentation

## Verified / reproduced research entries

### TerraForge
- API: WorldTile.Height
- Case study: safe New World UI cloning
- Troubleshooting: custom world becomes only ocean
- Failed approach: WorldTile.health is not terrain height

### Political World
- Case study: government initialization getter/setter recursion
- Troubleshooting: StackOverflow during recursive initialization
- Case study: Quiet Feed / political notification spam control
- Guide: separate simulation events from player-facing notifications
- Research inventory: Political World topics waiting for source/probe extraction

## AI rules
- Never present planned Political World mechanics as implemented facts.
- Distinguish project-internal methods from vanilla WorldBox APIs.
- Do not invent missing APIs or signatures.
- Prefer minimal probes when documentation is incomplete.
- Respect the WorldBox/NML version attached to each verified result.

## Languages
English is the root language.
Russian is available under /ru/.
Additional languages will be added progressively.
